headline: V26-3689: shared-machine capacity, so heavy runs claim from one machine ledger with measured costs and wait when it is full

V26-3680.title: Keep a machine ledger of claims, measured costs and a capacity

criteria.text: Plan Scenarios 1 to 9d, 14a to 14d, 17, 18, 20, 21, 23 to 24c and 25 pass.
status prints capacity and live pressure, and no admission reads load.
A claim whose process is dead is removed on the next read. A claim whose lock is held is kept, whatever its pid says.
A run through the real runner records non-null cpuSeconds, including its grandchild, and the next claim of that kind is measured.
No test reads or writes the real machine directory.
No fixed rule replaces the agent's judgement: every default can be stepped off with a recorded reason.

V26-3681.title: Claim for the queue's turn before the merge slot

criteria.text: Plan Scenarios 10, 11a to 11d, 22, 26 and 31 to 33 pass.
No code path waits on capacity while holding a merge slot. A claim from another process, a child of the slot holder included, waits as usual.
A check whose own argv claims runs under the turn's claim, in the runner's ledger, with no wait. Its environment digest and its record's names are unchanged.
Existing queue tests pass unchanged, with capacity left at the default and each test's own empty ledger.
No fixed rule replaces the agent's judgement.

V26-3682.title: Claim for fullHealth, lead-suite and any heavy run, and name the claim in the briefs

criteria.text: Plan Scenarios 12, 13, 19 and 27 to 30 pass.
A claim without --now waits behind a queue turn's claim, names it, and starts once the turn's claim is released.
A second supervisor pass while fullHealth waits starts no second run, and the ledger holds exactly one fullHealth claim.

Two pins cover the brief text: a corpus pin holds the sentence naming claim and --now --why, and an absence pin finds no scheduling rule in either brief, checking "only one", "one at a time", "never overlap", "must wait", "wait for", "do not run", "avoid running" and "before running" and their synonyms.
No fixed rule replaces the agent's judgement.

V26-3683.title: Show the machine in the lead's wait and the delivery views

criteria.text: Plan Scenarios 15a, 15b and 16a to 16c pass.
Existing render snapshots are unchanged when the machine directory is empty.
Every output-pinning test in tests/test_lead_wait.py and tests/test_orchestration_render.py reads its own machine directory with an explicit capacity.
No fixed rule replaces the agent's judgement.

V26-3693.title: Serve the hosted page in the same fonts as the local live view
V26-3693.why: The operator added it on 2026-11-20: the hosted page falls back to Georgia and the system sans because its policy and asset build carry none of the local view's fonts.

criteria.text: On the hosted page, Newsreader, Geist and Geist Mono load from the hosted origin, headings, body and mono text compute to the same families and weights as the local view, and the page's policy differs from today's only by font-src 'self', with no third-party request.

finish.label: The stories
finish.text: V26-3680, V26-3681, V26-3682 and V26-3683 land on integrate/shared-machine-capacity through its merge queue, meeting plan finish lines 1 to 6

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the integration head, with --workers 4 --budget tests/suite-budget.json, inside the budget, and no test reads or writes the real machine directory (plan finish line 7)

finish.label: Into main
finish.text: The integration base is reviewed for main, as the orchestrate-work guide's integration review says, and the operator merges it into main
